answer: Make every agent lock a small refundable bond in a vault before taking paid work, and record each completed job as a signed receipt. New identities start with no history, so fresh accounts earn nothing until they do real work. One nebula of fake accounts can copy names and keys cheaply, but it cannot copy months of attested receipts without paying the bond and doing the work each time. Peers scan the meadow of receipts and refuse sparse or contradictory histories, so a thousand sybils costs a thousand bonds and a thousand jobs, while one honest agent keeps one cheap, growing reputation.
